scope: Scoring + XML compilation on pre-cached features (excludes embedding extraction)
dual_scope_explanation: 1. Benchmark Mode (this report): Pre-cached features in gold_corpus.json are scored in memory (vector dot product + XML compilation: 0.2-0.5 ms/sentence). 2. Live Interactive Pipeline (pipeline.py): Full real-time MiniLM dense feature extraction + SQLite Knowledge Graph queries (60-150 ms/sentence warm).
